mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_todo (run_id, conversation_id, todo_id, content, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{runId}, #{conversationId}, #{todoId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_todo WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM ai_agent_todo WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND todo_id = #{todoId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_agent_todo WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_todo SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND todo_id = #{todoId}
